data.value: Validation complete. Check the preview and confirm to import.

data.name: Failed
data.value: Task failed ({0}). Check file format/limits, permissions and folder access; see the task center. No partial batch is accepted. For export, check that the search has 1–5,000 records and retry if records changed.

data.name: StartFailed
data.value: Could not start the operation. Check confirmation setup and task capacity, then retry.

data.name: PickerFailed
data.value: Could not select a local file/folder. Check desktop file picker support and access permissions.

data.name: Cancelling
data.value: Cancellation requested. Workbook loading/saving may take time to respond. A completed commit remains successful.

data.name: RequiredIssue
data.value: Code and name must not be empty.

data.name: LengthIssue
data.value: Code/name/remark exceed their 50/200/500 character limits.

data.name: DuplicateIssue
data.value: Code is duplicated in this file (case insensitive, ignoring surrounding whitespace).

data.name: TypeIssue
data.value: Use literal text cells. Numbers, dates, booleans and formulas are not imported.

data.name: HeaderIssue
data.value: Expected Code,Name,Remark or 编码,名称,备注 in that order.

data.name: EmptyIssue
data.value: A header and at least one data row are required.

data.name: TextIssue
data.value: Unsupported text or invalid cell contents.
